name: Evaluation
rows: Fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 · Ledgerwyn, Vellumrow, Charterfold and Quillpost · IT general controls workpapers
DRAFT FOR THE CPA · audit procedures · not an audit report · no opinion on internal control
ITGC-03 Administrator rights and manual entries
Entries far above materiality with no second person, and nothing in the systems to stop or record an override
ITGC-02 Conflicting duties, payments and payroll
Small so far, but a fictitious vendor or pay change could go through; the board must hear of it
No transaction followed; email reached after the last day
Weak sign-in; compensated in part by the office network for Ledgerwyn
The review would have found the others
Deficiency: a control that is missing or does not work, so a misstatement may not be prevented or caught in time.
Significant deficiency: less severe than a material weakness but important enough to merit the attention of those charged with governance.
Material weakness: a reasonable possibility that a material misstatement will not be prevented, or detected and corrected, on a timely basis.
AU-C 265, paraphrased, not quoted. Significant deficiencies and material weaknesses are communicated in writing; the CPA classifies.
